		if (a[i] == 'a' and a[i + 1] == 't') {
			b[index++] = '@';
			i += 1;
		}
		elif (a[i] == 'd' and a[i + 1] == 'o' and a[i + 2] == 't') {
			b[index++] = '.';
			i += 2;
		}
		else{
			b[index++] = a[i];
		}
	}
	b[index] = '\0';
	bool at = true;
	if (b[0] == '@') {
		cout << 'a' << 't';
	}
	elif(b[0] == '.') {
		cout << 'd' << 'o' << 't';
	}
	else {
		cout << b[0];
	}
	for (int i = 1; b[i];i++) {
		if (b[i]=='@') {
			if (at and i != index) {
				cout << '@';
				at = false;
			}
			else {
				cout << 'a' << 't';
			}
		}
		elif (b[i] == '.') {
			if (i != index) {
				cout << '.';
			}
			else {
				cout << 'd' << 'o' << 't';
			}
		}
		else {
			cout << b[i];
		}
	}
	cout << endl;
	return 0;
}
